method: Counterfactual screening only. Fix listed source A/fibre/protein/fat; residual100-sum-knownP bounds unreported species within that closed composition scenario, without subtracting derived water. Additional response factor0..150 is a proposed scenario, not measured GI, physiological upper bound or inherited PR156 approval. Whole-number display must be stable in every existing named scenario. The exact four-macro and display integration is NOT applied here.

sourceLimitations.referenceMaintenance: Local fibre null vs live web value is documented for393 and11134. No global importer bug established or bulk import changed.
